all.name: Black Widow
all.description: Natasha Romanova is the world's most elite spy in any era. Her mastery of the sniper rifle eliminates targets from afar, while her shock batons neutralize close-range threats. Black Widow is locked, loaded, and ready to deliver a fatal bite!

item.name: Widow's Bite Baton
item.description: Strike with the enhanced electric batons.

item.name: Red Room Rifle
item.description: Attack with the Red Room Rifle.

additional_fields.Damage_Falloff: Falloff begins at 10m, decreasing to 50% at 20m
additional_fields.Special_Effect: Shares the same magazine with Red Room Rifle. Straight Shooter activates only after aiming down sights for a specific duration; otherwise, it will fire from the Red Room Rifle

item.name: Straight Shooter
item.description: Switch the Red Room Rifle to Sniper mode to fire high-energy rounds.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: Shares the same magazine with Red Room Rifle

additional_fields.Damage_Falloff: Falloff begins at 10m, decreasing to 50% at 20m
additional_fields.Special_Effect: Shares the same magazine with Red Room Rifle. Straight Shooter activates only after aiming down sights for a specific duration; otherwise, it will fire from the Red Room Rifle

item.name: Infra-detector
item.description: Swap the next bullet for an Infra-Detector, revealing enemy positions in its area for a short duration.

item.name: Edge Dancer
item.description: Unleash a spinning kick to <Debuff>Launch Up</> enemies. Landing the hit will allow her to zip to the target with a grappling hook for a second kick.

item.name: High-energy Kick Select
item.description: When Edge Dancer is used and Black Widow is aloft, she can activate it again to unleash the accumulated energy, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

item.name: Fleet Foot
item.description: Dash forward and enable a powerful jump.

item.name: Electro-plasma Explosion
item.description: Switch the Red Room Rifle to Destruction mode and unleash an electro-plasma blast, damaging enemies within range and inflicting them with <Debuff>Vulnerability</>. Additionally, leave a plasma pool on the ground to <Debuff>Slow</> nearby enemies.

additional_fields.Explosion_Range: 5.6m - 8m (Maximum range is achieved after 0.6s of charging)
additional_fields.Explosion_Damage: 120 - 170 (Maximum damage is achieved after 0.6s of charging)
additional_fields.Number_of_Plasma_Globules: 7 - 20 (Maximum amount is achieved after 0.6s of charging)

item.name: LION'S LAUNCH
item.description: Attack with the Red Room Rifle.

item.name: FEROCIOUS THROW
item.description: Switch the Red Room Rifle to Sniper mode to fire high-energy rounds.
